title: Mean of the biased query score
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0<p<1$, and let $T$ be a decision tree on sign inputs with any set of leaf labels, whose queries are restricted to an available coordinate set. For each input, sum the standardized signs on the coordinates queried along its path. The mean of this sum under the product distribution in which each sign is $-1$ with probability $p$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: A finite coordinate set of size n
A decision tree with sign queries and arbitrary leaf labels
